bun.WebView: Native GUI bridge can open windows, browser processes and network connections.
bun.fetch: Immutable; parent proxy detects default calls. macOS sandbox denies bypass traffic; Linux proxy/unix/env bypasses remain OPEN.

modules.bun:ffi: Native FFI can call arbitrary OS functions, including sockets, processes and wall clocks.
modules.bun:wrap: Internal native wrapper bridge can expose native functions and real OS effects.
modules.module: Native addon loading through the module loader can execute arbitrary native OS effects.

globals.ffi: Native FFI can call arbitrary OS functions, including sockets, processes and wall clocks.

Bun.fetch.proxy.macos-sandbox: Denied by network policy, except the parent sink.
Bun.fetch.proxy.in-process-tripwire: Per-request proxy selects another proxy, bypassing the parent listener.

Bun.fetch.unix.macos-sandbox: Denied by network policy, except the parent sink.
Bun.fetch.unix.in-process-tripwire: Per-request unix connects to a local socket, bypassing the parent listener.

process.env/Bun.env proxy edits.macos-sandbox: Denied by network policy, except the parent sink.
process.env/Bun.env proxy edits.in-process-tripwire: Runtime refuses frozen env descriptors; edits can bypass inherited proxy routing on 1.4.4.
